'''Talnar''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] procurement officer. When [[Gender/Legends|he]] was 45 [[Standard year|years]] old, Talnar was forced to crash-land on the primitive world of [[Naalol/Legends|Naalol]] when his ship, the ''[[Golden Jewel]]'', was irreparably damaged by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces.<ref name="Talnar" />
